issues.description: Subjects has no class filter; only Students and Sections are targeted.
Some primary phone filters had not hydrated when count() was read; await real rows and then the visible primary filter. A filter menu is not present on single-filter tables.

Exams and Assessments use class as the primary phone filter, with title search inside the filter menu. The focused follow-up opens that menu and passes all four page/view combinations. Passing checks repeated by the follow-up are counted once.
Next.js indicator overlaps the left edge of the Arabic phone Next button. Use the uncovered right edge via a normal pointer click; no DOM, application or Next config changes.
